name: Business Website (4–5 pages)
description: Room to tell your story, with services, about, gallery and contact each on their own page.
pageIntro: A business website gives you room to tell your story properly, with a separate page for each part of your business so customers find what they need quickly and Google understands what you do.
whoItsFor: Established local businesses, trades, clinics, studios and service providers who want a site that answers customer questions and brings in enquiries.

details.heading: Typical pages
details.text: Home, services, about, gallery or past work, and contact. If you need something a little different, like a menu or a price list, we can swap a page.

details.heading: Set up for Google
details.text: Each page gets a clear title and description, the site gets a sitemap, and I connect it to Google Search Console at launch so you can see how people find you.

details.heading: How it works
details.text: After our first chat I design the look, then build the full site. You get two rounds of changes to get everything just right before it goes live, usually within 2 to 4 weeks.
